overview_description.description: DEX is in the business of identifying and delivering supply chain solutions at the lowest total cost to their clients by leveraging their engineering, systems, design, and consulting expertise. These infrastructures and core competencies give DEX an unmatched foundation for supply chain solutions.As a provider of supply chain solutions since 1980, DEX offers a variety of forward and reverse logistics programs for high-tech industries. As pioneers in the industry, DEX knows how it works. They have spent years building end-to-end supply chain solutions that include forward and reverse logistics, depot repair, parts procurement, and asset recovery services.DEX is dedicated to delivering end-to-end product lifecycle solutions at the lowest sustainable cost - enabling our customers to keep their commitments and stand out in their various industry segments. Their expertise is in engineering hi-tech electronic and electromechanical components, manufacturing, and supply chain management services. They offer solutions that span the entire product lifecycle - from concept through production and after-market support.

about_short_description.short_description: Business of identifying and delivering supply chain solutions.

product.name: Manufacturing Services
product.description: Provides complete product design, technology, and integrated manufacturing services for high-tech electronic and electromechanical products.

product.name: Engineering Services
product.description: Offers design, reverse engineering, and product enhancement services to improve or extend the functionality and lifespan of high-tech electronic products.

product.name: Depot Repair Services
product.description: Manages receipt, screening, testing, repair, and return of electronic and electromechanical components to extend product lifecycle and control costs.

product.name: Service Parts Management
product.description: Manages supply chain logistics and restocking processes for service parts essential to equipment maintenance and operation.

product.name: Returns Management
product.description: Provides management of product returns to reduce costs and improve speed, visibility, and control of return center operations.

product.name: Spare Parts Procurement
product.description: Sources and procures spare parts globally through a network of OEMs and manufacturers to support equipment maintenance and repair.
